thingsToDo.title: Visit Portland Museum of Art
thingsToDo.description: Portland Museum of Art is a district in Portland, Maine. Portland Museum of Art anchors the city’s Arts District with collections that range from American classics to contemporary exhibits. The galleries are approachable for a short visit, and the location is close to cafés and bookshops for easy pairing. Plan an hour or two to see the highlights and rotating shows.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Casco Bay Lines Ferry Terminal
thingsToDo.description: Casco Bay Lines Ferry Terminal is a waterfront in Portland, Maine. Casco Bay Lines Ferry Terminal is the jumping-off point for island ferries, offering a front-row view of Portland’s working harbor. Even if you are not boarding a ferry, the terminal area is a pleasant waterfront stop with benches and photo angles. It is a simple way to soak in the bay atmosphere before heading deeper into town.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Portland Observatory
thingsToDo.description: Portland Observatory is a waterfront in Portland, Maine. Portland Observatory is a historic maritime signal tower perched above the Eastern Promenade. Climbing to the top rewards you with panoramic views over Casco Bay, the harbor, and the city rooftops. It is a compact historic stop that offers one of the best urban viewpoints in Portland.
